    • fromDocText

      public DocBuilder fromDocText(DocText docText)
      Description copied from interface: DocBuilder
      Copies the javadoc from a DocText object into this builder. Existing content in the builder is not overwritten. Note that additional paragraphs created with DocBuilder.extraP(String) are not effected by this method.
      Specified by:
      fromDocText in interface DocBuilder
      Parameters:
      docText - the DocText object
      Returns:
      this builder

    • extraP

      public DocBuilder extraP(String paragraph)
      Description copied from interface: DocBuilder
      Adds a paragraph to the Javadoc. Paragraphs are added in the given order. In standard javadoc output, paragraphs are wrapped in <p> tags. In contrast to DocBuilder.p(String), additionalParagraphs are not effected by DocBuilder.fromDocText(DocText), thus the result would a combination of the copy source's paragraphs and the additional paragraphs. This is useful for taking the content of a method's javadoc and adding additional information for a specific use case.
      Specified by:
      extraP in interface DocBuilder
      Parameters:
      paragraph - the paragraph to add
      Returns:
      this builder

    • template

      public DocBuilder template(String key, String value)
      Description copied from interface: DocBuilder
      Adds a template value to the builder. Templates are placeholders in the Javadoc that can be replaced when the javadoc is rendered. The key is the name of the template, the value is the replacement. Template values consist of two curly braces around the key, e.g. {{key}}.
      Specified by:
      template in interface DocBuilder
      Parameters:
      key - the key of the template
      value - the value of the template
      Returns:
      this builder
